before: Extension-style content types such as image/.png are ignored, so a picture of that type drops from a rich copy and paste.
after: Extension-style content types resolve where uncontested and yield to a conflicting record. Pasted pictures of that type land under their sniffed standard type.
reason: Shared operations, identities, fields, and package serialization stay unchanged. A seeding participant may now write an extension-style value into the existing content-type maps. Released readers accept any string there, so every participant in a room reads the same lookup; a room seeded by a released participant keeps the lookup it wrote. A paste replicates the sniffed standard type through the existing resource effects. Packages that open for released readers still open. The regression covers current participants; the release fixture has no extension-style types.
